rows.text: calls the function at `0017D900` + 0x4 and returns its null result when it returns null; otherwise calls it again (`0017D900` + 0xE) and returns byte `+0x10E0` of that result zero-extended

returns 0 in `al` when `r8` is null; otherwise calls the function at `0020B9A0` + 0x29 with `rcx+0x58`, searches the tree rooted at qword `rcx+0x38` (header `rcx+0x28`, children qwords `[node]` and `+8`) for a node whose dword `+0x20` equals `edx` (unsigned lower-bound walk) and, when one is found, decrements byte `+0x10` of its qword `+0x28` if that byte is non-zero; then calls the functions at `0020B9A0` + 0x82 with `rcx+0x58`, at `0020B9A0` + 0x8A with `r8` and at `0020B9A0` + 0x97 with `r8` and 0x10, and returns 1 in `al`

notes: Callees cited by site because the host excerpts do not name them. 0020B9A0: the walk keeps the last node whose key is not below edx, moving to qword +8 from it and to qword [node] past smaller keys; a candidate whose key is above edx is replaced by the header, so only an exact match is used.
